name: Bradenton / Hunsader Farms KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday on Hunsader Farms, a family-owned working farm in rural east Manatee County, with a petting zoo and pick-your-own produce market beside the campground. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: koa.com reserve form read 2026-10-21: 1-night stays (Tue 02/16/2027 and Tue 05/11/2027) sell 9 RV site types (gravel back-ins and pull-thrus, W/E and full hookup) for a 23-ft motorhome, park page lists 85 ft max length; satellite shows ~150 RV pads in open rows, no residential/seasonal structures -> real transient RV campground; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri World Imagery, read 2026-10-21) at 27.44524,-82.30853: RV rows on open farmland; only water is a small landscaped/stormwater pond north of the loops at ~27.4471,-82.3093, separated from the nearest pads by the loop road and its graded bank (developed strip, not an open apron); no lake/river nearby -> default down
fees_source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/bradenton/reserve/ via koa.py, read 2026-10-21, 2 adults, 23-ft motorhome, 1 night Tue 02/16/2027 and Tue 05/11/2027 (same rates both): Back In 30A W/E $72.00 avg/night (cheapest), Pull Thru 30A W/E $72, up to Pull Thru full-hookup KOA Patio $150; before tax, KOA Select My Site +$25 optional; no mandatory per-night fee shown
flags: A 10/4/2026 camper review says 'so happy to have the koa open again' and an Oct 2026 review mentions the farm festival was canceled, so the park appears to have reopened after a closure (likely hurricane-related); it is selling nights now.
Extended stays are offered alongside nightly sites; no minimum stay surfaced for a 1-night winter weeknight.
